payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_history_run.py::test_every_lens_reads_the_history_run_and_the_task_dir_records_it stayed green with the spec's wrong version 'A history cell entered for a spec with no `history`.' applied to saffron/intake.py as an edit. The claim was "For a spec declaring `history`, REVIEW runs the in-cell copy and then the command, each once, in the Gate-only cell that carries the history mount. It does so after a clean gate comparison and before any lens, inside the same `try` as the lens critic cell. So a gate comparison that errored ends `GATE_ERROR` with no history exec. A history cell that refuses the patch ends `EXHAUSTED` with no history exec and no lens. Every lens's system prompt carries the command, both streams, and either `exited` with the exit code or `timed out`. `history.json` in the task directory records the command, the exit code, `timed_out` and both streams. A spec declaring no `history` gets no history mount, no `history.json` and no `History run` text in any lens prompt. The witness tells the history cell apart by its exec argv, never by a container name. It drives a run that exits 3, a run that times out, a gate comparison that errored, a history cell whose patch apply fails, and a spec with no `history`.", and only that witness ran under the edit.
